description.value: Oceanside Convenience Store is a neighbourhood convenience shop on Marine Drive in Tsawwassen, situated in a coastal community near the BC Ferries Tsawwassen terminal. For cyclists riding the South Fraser or ferry-connection routes, it represents a potential resupply point close to the water. The store's proximity to the terminal approach road could make it a useful last stop before boarding or a first stop after arriving by ferry.

The Facebook page fetch was blocked by Facebook's rate-limiter, returning no usable business content — all amenity fields must default to null except Basic groceries, which is implied by the OSM shop=convenience tag. No phone or additional contact details are available in OSM or from the website.

A manual check or direct visit is needed to confirm cyclist-relevant amenities (bike parking, water refill) before including it in the directory.
